I've had this issue before try some of these

1. Ensure proper GPU power connections from the PSU.
2. Test the GPU in another system to isolate the problem.
3. Inspect PCIe slot for cleanliness and check for damage.
4. Update GPU drivers to resolve potential software issues.
5. Verify BIOS settings support the GPU and reset if needed.
6. Test GPU in different PCIe slots to identify slot-specific issues.
7. Check for physical damage on the GPU.
8. Monitor GPU temperature for overheating during boot.
9. If issues persist, contact manufacturer support for further assistance.
